segments.source: Like with the [`View`](view.md) protocol, you can create custom table row content by declaring a type that conforms to the `TableRowContent` protocol and implementing the required [`tableRowBody`](tablerowcontent/tablerowbody-swift.property.md) property.
segments.normalizedSource: Like with the [`View`](view.md) protocol, you can create custom table row content by declaring a type that conforms to the `TableRowContent` protocol and implementing the required [`tableRowBody`](tablerowcontent/tablerowbody-swift.property.md) property.

```swift struct GroupOfPeopleRows: TableRowContent { @Binding var people: [Person] var tableRowBody: some TableRowContent<Person> { ForEach(people) { person in TableRow(person) .itemProvider { person.itemProvider } } .dropDestination(for: Person.self) { destination, newPeople in people.insert(contentsOf: newPeople, at: destination) } } } ```
